latest.title: Launch of Proprietary Live Commerce Software & JV
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 0303R
Huddled Group PLC
18 August 2026
HUDDLED GROUP PLC
("Huddled" or the "Company")
Launch of Proprietary Live Commerce Software and Joint Venture
Huddled Group plc AIM: HUD, the circular-economy e-commerce group, announces the launch of its proprietary live-commerce technology and the formation of a joint venture with AEWW Limited ("AEWW"), operator of the AE Stores channel on Whatnot.
Scalable live-commerce infrastructure
Live commerce is the fusion of live-streaming, auctions, community chat and entertainment. It is reshaping how consumers shop online, with platforms such as Whatnot, TikTok Shop and eBay Live driving rapid growth in buyer engagement and order volumes.
Huddled has developed software intended to address a key constraint in scaling live commerce: the coordination of stock, orders and fulfilment across multiple sellers and platforms.
The system connects third-party live-commerce sellers to Huddled's centralised stock pool and fulfilment infrastructure. This allows presenters to focus on content and sales, while Huddled manages stock allocation, order processing and delivery.
The Board considers that this integrated model enables the Group to operate a network of live-commerce channels and partners, supported by shared inventory and centralised fulfilment, improving stock utilisation and operational efficiency.
Joint venture with AEWW
Huddled has entered into a joint venture with AEWW to accelerate growth in live auctions under the Peeko brand. AEWW, which was incorporated in March 2026, has grown its AE Stores following on Whatnot to 36.5k in under six months.
Powered by Huddled's newly-developed software solution, AE Stores will be rebranded Peeko Gadgets and brought into the venture alongside the existing Peeko stores which focus on beauty and treats, with further stores to be launched on the Whatnot platform as the venture scales.
The joint venture will focus exclusively on the Whatnot platform, which is the leader in this emerging sector. Current dwell times (time a consumer spends on site) are circa 90 minutes on this platform compared to only a few minutes on traditional e-commerce platforms.
Martin Higginson, Executive Chairman of Huddled Group plc, commented:
"Our early live commerce tests produced very encouraging results, prompting us to develop a proprietary software solution for this fast-growing market. Our software lets sellers focus entirely on what they do best: selling. Behind the scenes, they will be tapping into our centralised stock pool and fulfilment engine. The ability to offer next-day delivery on these platforms will, we believe, be a genuine game changer.
"The addition of AE Stores' audience and experience provides immediate scale. Under the Peeko brand, we expect to expand into further channels, categories and partnerships."
Jason McNeill and Regan McNeill, Joint Managing Directors of AEWW Limited, said:
"The biggest challenge we faced as a business was fulfilment - every time we accelerated sales, we hit a bottleneck on stock and delivery. The partnership with Huddled will remove those barriers entirely. Being able to offer next-day delivery on orders placed up to 11pm gives us a real USP in the Whatnot marketplace.
"We can now focus on our core strength - building a strong community and driving sales in what is the fastest-growing sector in e-commerce. With the stock and fulfilment headache solved, we can scale with confidence across additional stores and streams. We are pleased to bring AE Stores into the Peeko brand as Peeko Gadgets and see strong potential to scale the model further."
Enquiries:

company_30s.what_they_do: HUD.L runs a niche digital marketplace that connects small‑business owners with specialized service providers.  The platform handles everything from booking to payment, aiming to simplify the procurement process for its users.
company_30s.why_they_matter: The market for online B2B service exchanges is growing rapidly, especially as businesses look for cost‑effective, on‑demand solutions.  HUD.L’s model targets a segment that is underserved by the larger, generic marketplaces, giving it a potential competitive edge if it can scale.
company_30s.current_state: The firm is in a fundraising phase, having recently issued new shares and options to raise capital.  It is actively engaging shareholders through a series of AGMs and retail offers, signalling a focus on rebuilding liquidity and stabilising operations.

rns_narrative: The company is actively raising capital—oversubscribed retail offers and new share options have been announced to shore up its balance sheet.
Corporate governance is being refreshed: recent AGM results and notices of general meetings indicate a push to align shareholder interests and prepare for future growth.
Financial updates are coming: the latest full‑year results and trading update give insight into cash flow and operating performance, offering a potential catalyst if the numbers improve.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet optimism around capital‑raising moves, but overall chatter is low.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: A handful of traders see the fresh capital as a sign that the business can invest in product development and expand its user base, expecting a rebound once the market digests the new shares.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Others caution that the heavy dilution could erode earnings per share and that market makers are keeping a tight spread, potentially trapping small investors.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The mood has stayed steady; a slight uptick in bullish posts appears after the announcement of the oversubscribed retail offer, but no major shift in sentiment has occurred.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends data is flat, indicating no public search interest—perfect for a contrarian play.

near_term_catalysts: Completion of the oversubscribed retail offer will inject fresh capital and could lift confidence in the stock.
Release of the next quarterly results could show improved cash flow or a turnaround in operating metrics.
A technical breakout above the 0.75p gap—identified in recent chatter—would signal that the support level is holding and that a mean‑reversion is underway.
Any announced partnership or product launch in the next two months would provide a tangible business catalyst.
expect_next.watch_for: Look for a volume spike that coincides with the share‑offering close and a price move that clears the 0.75p support.  A sustained rally past 0.75p would confirm the thesis.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock appears to be in the early post‑crash phase, with the APEX score suggesting tight compression.  Mean reversion will likely take several weeks to months; patience is required.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: HUD.L is trading well below its historical low, and the recent capital raise suggests the company is positioned to invest in growth.  If the share price recovers to the midpoint between current and its all‑time high, the upside could be 5‑10× the current value, a classic deep‑crash payoff.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The dilution from the new shares could shrink earnings per share, and market makers appear to be maintaining a tight spread that may keep the price depressed.  A worst‑case scenario is that the share price stays near the 0.75p support or falls further if the company fails to deliver on its growth plans.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Risk is limited to the current price level (small relative to the potential upside).  A 5‑10× return is realistic if mean reversion occurs, giving a risk‑to‑reward ratio of roughly 1:5–10.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter on a breakout above 0.75p with a tight stop just below that level.  Size the position at 5% of portfolio equity, and add to the trade only if volume confirms the move.
playbook.if_watching: Wait for the share‑offering to close and for a volume spike that pushes the price above 0.75p.  If the price stalls or falls below 0.70p, reconsider.
playbook.if_passing: No terminal risk has surfaced; the setup remains bullish as long as the share offering is completed and the price respects the 0.75p support.

ai_insights.bottom_line: HUD.L’s deep crash and fresh capital injection create a high‑reward mean‑reversion opportunity, but dilution and market‑maker tactics remain the primary risks.
